XCOMP.CLK@trunk_top.definition: pins_um is the centre of the top CLK via stack; the M3 trunk itself ends one via half-length above it

notes.text: pins_um XCOMP.CLK@trunk_top [46.115, 72.33] is the centre of the top M3_M2 stack at local [0.0, -0.28]. The M3 trunk ends at local y -0.225 (core y 72.385); interfaces.json rounds that edge to -0.23. The M4 drop ends on the via centre, so its via3 stacks on the existing via2.

All nine M3 tracks are clear from the pin ends (local x 64.71) to the outline: no M3 or via M3 enclosure in their half-pitch bands, searched at full depth to local x 67.334. The row-end cell XREF/ROW_BOUNDARY_RIGHT_460 sits in the row above the bus.
The XREF east outline (local x 66.834, core x 78.549) is set by the text label of XREF/ROW_BOUNDARY_RIGHT_460; drawn XREF geometry ends at local x 64.98 (core x 76.695).
The layout_r3 OA bbox exceeds its prBoundary by standard-cell text only (+1.399 um east, +0.081 um west); drawn geometry stays inside the boundary. Block bbox checks use the boundary.
VINN/VINP pin text overhangs the native bbox by 0.044/0.046 um; drawn geometry is the native bbox.

notes.topic: SAR metal under the M7 tracks
notes.text: The macro has no M7, VIA6, VIA7 or M8. M5 holds only 0.4 x 0.25 um via pads on the rail rows; M6 holds four full-height stripes (VDD x 3.08-3.48, VSS x 3.88-4.28, VDD x 10.08-10.48, VSS x 10.88-11.28), which every M7 track crosses. The nearest M5/M6 edge that does not cross a track centre is 0.275 um away. Top-level via6/via7 onto the stripes must stay off the track rows.
